documents.text:
thalia field, lubec, ME.
PLease do not approve a permit for the DeepGreen compute data center. This is an affront to the autonomy of the region, and a dangerous insertion of a resource-depleting and unproven and risky technology. There is no way to mitigate the risk to our community at this time and this permit should not be allowed now. There are multiple questions involving safety and damage that are unresolved. This is hasty and imprudent. Please do not grant this permit. Thank you.
